$comment: Pairs the current tokens fail, found when ArchiveUx was set up (stage 1, 2026-11-19). Each is a FINDING for the owner: the look is the owner's, so values are not changed until the owner decides. The check reports these and does not fail on them; it fails on any other failure, and on an entry here that no longer fails. When the owner decides, change the token (or the pattern) and take the entry off.

findings.note: Alerts (an admin's backup and upgrade alerts) are a warn-bg fill with no edge; a must-notice element needs an edge of 4.5:1 against the page.
Console's dark accent is light, so the heat grid's shades lighten towards the text colour: the busiest cell's count is 3.55:1.
